title: North Bay Island - The Adventure Capital of Andaman Islands
content:
North Bay Island,

North Bay Island is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, renowned for its vibrant coral reefs, crystal-clear waters, and thrilling water sports activities. Located just a short ferry ride from Port Blair, the island attracts adventure enthusiasts, nature lovers, photographers, and families from around the world.

The island is particularly famous because its lighthouse is featured on the reverse side of the Indian ₹20 currency note, making it one of the most recognizable landmarks in the Andaman Islands. With breathtaking underwater marine life and exciting adventure opportunities, North Bay Island offers an unforgettable tropical island experience.

History of North Bay Island

While North Bay Island does not have a colonial history like Ross Island or Cellular Jail, it has long been recognized for its strategic coastal location and rich marine biodiversity.

Over the years, the island evolved into one of the most important marine tourism hubs in the Andaman Islands. Government tourism initiatives helped develop facilities for water sports and eco-tourism while preserving the island's fragile coral ecosystem.

Today, North Bay Island is known as the center of underwater adventure activities in Andaman and plays a major role in promoting marine tourism in India.

Why Visit North Bay Island?

North Bay Island is a paradise for adventure seekers and marine life enthusiasts.

Visitors come here to enjoy:

  • Scuba diving
  • Snorkeling
  • Sea walking
  • Glass-bottom boat rides
  • Coral reef exploration
  • Underwater photography
  • Lighthouse viewpoints
  • Scenic island landscapes

The island offers some of the best underwater visibility in the Andaman Islands.

Major Attractions at North Bay Island

1. North Bay Lighthouse

The iconic lighthouse is one of the island's most famous attractions.

It gained national recognition after appearing on the reverse side of India's ₹20 currency note. Visitors can capture stunning photographs of this landmark surrounded by turquoise waters.

2. Coral Reefs

North Bay Island is home to some of the most colorful coral reefs in the Andaman Islands.

The reefs support a diverse marine ecosystem, including:

  • Clownfish
  • Butterflyfish
  • Parrotfish
  • Sea cucumbers
  • Starfish
  • Various coral species

The clear waters provide excellent opportunities for observing marine life.

3. Scuba Diving

Scuba diving is among the most popular activities on the island.

Both beginners and certified divers can explore:

  • Coral gardens
  • Tropical fish species
  • Underwater rock formations
  • Marine biodiversity

Professional instructors and certified dive operators ensure safe experiences for visitors.

4. Snorkeling

Snorkeling allows visitors to enjoy the underwater world without requiring extensive training.

The shallow reef areas are perfect for beginners who want to witness colorful marine life up close.

5. Sea Walking

Sea walking is a unique underwater activity where visitors wear specialized helmets and walk on the seabed.

This activity offers:

  • Close interaction with marine life
  • No swimming skills required
  • Safe underwater exploration
  • Memorable photography opportunities

6. Glass-Bottom Boat Ride

Visitors who prefer staying dry can enjoy a glass-bottom boat ride.

The transparent viewing panels allow tourists to observe:

  • Coral formations
  • Exotic fish
  • Underwater ecosystems

This activity is ideal for families and senior travelers.

Marine Life at North Bay Island

The waters surrounding the island support an impressive range of marine species.

Visitors may encounter:

  • Angelfish
  • Butterflyfish
  • Clownfish
  • Triggerfish
  • Sea anemones
  • Hard and soft corals
  • Crustaceans
  • Reef ecosystems

The island is considered one of the best locations for marine biodiversity viewing in Andaman.

Best Time to Visit

  • October to May: The ideal season for visiting North Bay Island. Weather conditions remain pleasant with calm seas and excellent underwater visibility.
  • December to April: The best period for scuba diving, snorkeling, and sea walking.
  • June to September: Monsoon conditions may affect ferry operations and water sports activities.

How to Reach North Bay Island

By Air: 

  • The nearest airport is Veer Savarkar International Airport in Port Blair.

By Ferry:

  • Regular ferries operate from the Water Sports Complex in Port Blair.
  • Travel time typically ranges between 20 and 30 minutes.
  • Many visitors combine North Bay Island with Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Island (Ross Island) in a single-day tour package.

Things to Carry

  • Sunglasses
  • Sunscreen
  • Hat or cap
  • Comfortable beachwear
  • Waterproof phone pouch
  • Camera
  • Drinking water
  • Extra clothing

Travel Tips

  • Book water sports activities through authorized operators.
  • Follow all safety instructions.
  • Avoid touching coral reefs.
  • Carry cash for small purchases.
  • Arrive early to maximize sightseeing time.
  • Respect marine conservation guidelines.

Nearby Attractions

Popular attractions often combined with North Bay Island include:

  • Cellular Jail
  • Corbyn’s Cove Beach
  • Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Island
  • Chidiya Tapu
  • Samudrika Marine Museum
excerpt: North Bay Island is the adventure hub of the Andaman Islands, famous for its coral reefs, scuba diving, snorkeling, and sea walking experiences. Located near Port Blair, the island attracts travelers seeking underwater adventures and breathtaking marine biodiversity. Its iconic lighthouse and crystal-clear waters make it one of the most visited destinations in Andaman.

faqs.question: Why is North Bay Island famous?
faqs.answer: North Bay Island is famous for water sports activities, coral reefs, marine biodiversity, and its iconic lighthouse featured on India's ₹20 note.

faqs.question: How far is North Bay Island from Port Blair?
faqs.answer: The island is approximately 5 kilometers from Port Blair and can be reached by ferry.

faqs.question: Is scuba diving available for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, beginners can participate in guided scuba diving sessions with certified instructors.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit North Bay Island?
faqs.answer: October to May is considered the best time for sightseeing and water activities.

faqs.question: Can non-swimmers enjoy activities here?
faqs.answer: Yes, activities such as sea walking and glass-bottom boat rides are suitable for non-swimmers.
